jellyfin.allow_shirox_under_settings_pri: Allow Shirox under Settings → Privacy & Security → Local Network.
jellyfin.connect_detail_mac: Type that address and your Jellyfin username and password into this screen and click Connect. Your libraries then show up in Shirox.
jellyfin.connect_detail_phone: Type that address and your Jellyfin username and password into this screen and tap Connect. Your libraries then show up in Shirox.
jellyfin.couldnt_reach_the_server_check: Couldn't reach the server. Check the address and your network.
jellyfin.find_address_detail_mac: It's the server computer's local IP address followed by :8096, for example http://192.168.1.10:8096, or http://localhost:8096 when it runs on this Mac. Your Mac needs to be on the same network. To watch away from home you need Jellyfin's remote access set up, or a domain pointing at your server.
jellyfin.find_address_detail_phone: It's the server computer's local IP address followed by :8096, for example http://192.168.1.10:8096. Your phone needs to be on the same network. To watch away from home you need Jellyfin's remote access set up, or a domain pointing at your server.
jellyfin.how_do_i_set_this: How do I set this up?
jellyfin.in_the_jellyfin_dashboard_open: In the Jellyfin dashboard, open Libraries and add a folder of shows or movies. Name episodes like \"Show Name/Season 01/Show Name S01E01.mkv\" so Jellyfin can match them.
jellyfin.include_http_and_the_port: Include http:// and the port, e.g. :8096.
jellyfin.jellyfin_is_a_free_media: Jellyfin is a free media server that runs on your Mac, PC or NAS. Download it from jellyfin.org/downloads, start it, and finish the setup wizard it opens in your browser. That's where you create the username and password you'll use here.
jellyfin.make_sure_the_server_is: Make sure the server is running and your computer's firewall allows port 8096.
jellyfin.open_in_safari_mac: Open the same address in Safari on your Mac. If it doesn't load there, it's the network, not the app.
jellyfin.open_in_safari_phone: Open the same address in Safari on your phone. If it doesn't load there, it's the network, not the app.

modules.file_replaces_editor: Everything in the editor is replaced with the file's script. Nothing is kept until you tap Save.
modules.optional_a_modules_json_fills: Optional. A module's .json fills in the details below; you can still change them. The script above is needed either way.

modules.paste_a_modules_json_link: Paste a module's .json link, a Stremio addon, or a Nuvio, Vega, SkyStream or Mana repo, or import a module's .js file (and its .json, if you have it).
modules.paste_replaces_editor: Everything in the editor is replaced with what's on your clipboard.

modules.required_the_modules_javascript_: Required. The module's JavaScript, from a .js file or written in the editor: what it searches, lists and plays.
modules.saved_like_this_the_module: Saved like this, the module won't work.

modules.that_link_is_a_cloudstream: That link is a CloudStream repo. CloudStream plugins are Android code, which Shirox can't run.
modules.that_link_is_a_list: That link is a list of modules. Adding a whole list isn't supported yet — paste one module's .json link.
modules.that_link_is_a_script: That link is a script, not a module. Paste the .json link beside it instead, or download the .js and pick it with Import from Files.
modules.that_link_is_a_web: That link is a web page, not a module. On GitHub, open the file and use its Raw link.
modules.that_link_is_an_image: That link is an image, not a module. Paste the module's .json link instead.
modules.that_link_isnt_a_module: That link isn't a module, a Stremio addon, or a Nuvio, Vega, SkyStream or Mana repo Shirox can add.
modules.the_original_script_couldnt_be: The original script couldn't be downloaded. Your edits are still there.
modules.the_script_has_a_syntax: The script has a syntax error
modules.the_site_asked_for_a: The site asked for a browser check. Verify, and this module tries again.
modules.theres_no_text_on_the: There's no text on the clipboard.
modules.this_addon_has_nothing_shirox: This addon has nothing Shirox can search: it needs a search catalog, or Kitsu or IMDb ids.
modules.this_plugin_file_has_no: This plugin file has no script Shirox can run.
modules.this_repo_has_no_providers: This repo has no providers Shirox can add.

settings.a_click_anywhere_on_a: A click anywhere on a page shows and hides the controls.
settings.a_frosted_circle_holds_the: A frosted circle holds the spinner, as sheets always have.
settings.a_positive_delay_shows_subtitle: A positive delay shows subtitles sooner, a negative one later.
settings.a_proxy_for_all_traffic: A proxy for all traffic needs iOS 17, macOS 14 or tvOS 17.
settings.a_tap_anywhere_on_a: A tap anywhere on a page shows and hides the controls.
settings.an_edit_you_make_to: An edit you make to a title — its status, progress, score, or removing it — is also written to every other service switched on here. Services left off change only through the sync runs below.
settings.auto_pick_choices_reuse_your: Auto-pick choices reuse your previous source and stream selections when opening an episode or chapter.
settings.automatically_skip_intros_recap: Automatically skip intros, recaps, credits, and previews
settings.automatically_update_your_watch: Automatically update your watch progress as you watch.
settings.brings_your_two_accounts_into: Brings your two accounts into line — a one-time backfill for everything you tracked before signing in here. Syncing both ways reconciles them in a single pass; the one-way copies only ever write to the destination. Either way progress is only ever moved forward, so anything further along is left as it is.
settings.buttons_switches_and_highlights: Buttons, switches and highlights. Monochrome keeps Shirox black and white; the colors adjust themselves to light and dark mode.
settings.checks_tmdbs_api_and_images: Checks TMDB's API and images, then encrypted DNS and the proxy if they're on, asking Cloudflare which address it sees. DNS and proxy changes apply after a restart.
settings.choose_which_log_categories_to: Choose which log categories to record. Debug and HTMLStrings can be very verbose.
settings.clear_everything_removes_caches: Clear Everything removes caches the app can rebuild. It keeps your watch progress, which has its own reset. Website Data includes cookies and local storage from module scrapers. Search Aliases store remembered search results and stream picks per module. The Network Cache holds saved answers from sites and services.
settings.clears_continue_watching_and_ev: Clears Continue Watching and every Watched mark in episode lists on this device. AniList, MyAnimeList and Simkl aren't changed.
settings.clears_cookies_website_data_the: Clears cookies, website data, the web cache, solved Cloudflare checks and the remembered TMDB host. Settings here stay.
settings.click_the_right_side_to: Click the right side to scroll down or turn to the next page, the left to go back; right to left reading swaps them. The middle shows and hides the controls.
settings.cloudflare_https_cloudflare_dns: Cloudflare: https://cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query at 1.1.1.1. Google: https://dns.google/dns-query at 8.8.8.8. If the server can't be reached, nothing loads; turn this off to recover.
settings.custom_lists_are_managed_on: Custom lists are managed on AniList.
settings.did_he_give_you_any: Did he give you any clues,\nany coordinates, anything?
settings.download_quality_picks_the_rend: Download Quality picks the rendition for streams that offer several, falling back to the closest below. A downloaded episode keeps the one it was saved in. Delete After Watching removes a downloaded episode once you finish it and close the player. Retry downloads that were interrupted or failed when the app next opens — off by default so reopening the app never starts a large transfer on cellular without you asking.
settings.downloaded_episodes_and_chapter: Downloaded episodes and chapters aren't a cache, so Clear Everything leaves them alone. Delete single episodes from the Downloads tab, or turn on Delete After Watching in Download Settings.
settings.drag_to_reorder_settings_always: Drag to reorder. Settings always stays, so hidden tabs can come back.
settings.drag_to_reorder_the_first: Drag to reorder. The first provider is primary; the second is used as fallback.
settings.drag_to_reorder_title_priority: Drag to reorder title priority for display and matching.
settings.every_downloaded_episode_and_ch: Every downloaded episode and chapter will be removed from this device. You can download them again later.
settings.everything_in_the_backup_was: Everything in the backup was restored.
settings.everything_overwrite_does_and_t: Everything Overwrite does, and the overwritten account also loses any entry the other doesn't have, ending up an exact copy. Entries whose match can't be confirmed are kept rather than deleted. This can't be undone.
settings.fills_the_bars_around_the: Fills the bars around the video with a soft glow of its colours. Native engine only.
settings.how_far_your_finger_may: How far your finger may drift before a hold is recognized. Raise it if the hold action keeps cancelling.
settings.in_use_from_the_next: in use from the next start
settings.it_also_signs_this_device: It also signs this device into the accounts saved in the backup.
settings.keep_the_reader_upright_turn: Keep the reader upright. Turn off to read sideways when you turn your phone.
settings.keeps_a_video_playing_when: Keeps a video playing when you leave the app. Off, it pauses, unless it's in Picture in Picture, on AirPlay or cast to a TV.
settings.lets_ios_play_videos_in: Lets iOS play videos in Spatial Audio, with its movie sound processing, on AirPods and other headphones. Turn off for plain stereo, or if headphones play quieter here than in other apps. Takes effect from the next video.
settings.loads_smaller_artwork_and_skips: Loads smaller artwork and skips the large banner images on Home. Posters look softer; everything still works, and downloads and playback are unaffected.
settings.looks_up_servers_over_encrypted: Looks up servers over encrypted DNS, for networks that tamper with it. Not for video or web views; a device DNS profile or VPN comes first. Applies after a restart.
settings.marks_shows_youre_watching_that: Marks shows you're watching that have aired episodes you haven't seen, with a dot for ones that came out since you last opened the show. Sort by New Episodes First from the Library's sort menu.
settings.missing_yours_open_an_issue: Missing yours? Open an issue on GitHub; translations are welcome too.
settings.mpv_plays_more_formats_like: MPV plays more formats, like MKV, and more subtitle styles. AirPlay moves playback to Native, or sends only the sound when Native can't play it. Native switches to MPV by itself when it can't play something.
settings.needs_a_host_and_a: Needs a host and a port, and a password with a username
settings.needs_a_host_and_port: Needs a host and port, and a password with a username; off until then.
settings.needs_an_https_url_and: Needs an https URL and at least one IP address
settings.needs_https_url_footer: Needs an https URL and an IP address; off until then.
settings.no_valid_api_or_image: No valid API or image address yet.
settings.no_valid_custom_tmdb_proxy: No valid custom TMDB proxy for \(host)
settings.on_couldnt_be_matched_against: \(plan.keptUnverified) on \(run.targetName) couldn't be matched against \(run.sourceName), so they're kept rather than deleted.
settings.on_have_no_entry_to: \(plan.unmatched.count) on \(run.sourceName) have no \(run.targetName) entry to write to.
settings.pauses_while_control_center_or: Pauses while Control Center or Notification Center is open and picks up again when you close it. Leaving the app or locking the phone still plays in the background.
settings.player_glass_note: Frosted glass buttons in the video player. Turn off for solid controls.
settings.posters_from_tvdb_carry_the: Posters from TVDB carry the show's name, so the title over them says it twice. Hold a card for its full title.
settings.progress_data_from_an_incompati: Progress data from an incompatible app version (found \(found), expected \(expected)).
settings.progress_library_settings_and_m: Progress, library, settings and modules. No login tokens, so the file is safe to share.
settings.pulling_down_still_refreshes_wi: Pulling down still refreshes, with nothing on screen: a tap when you've pulled far enough, another when it's done.
settings.pulling_stretches_a_drop_out: Pulling stretches a drop out of the Dynamic Island that holds the spinner.
settings.reader_glass_note: Frosted glass buttons in the manga reader. Turn off for solid controls.
settings.removes_every_downloaded_episod: Removes every downloaded episode and chapter. Kept out of cache resets — these are files you saved for offline use, not a cache the app can rebuild.
settings.replaces_https_api_themoviedb_o: Replaces https://api.themoviedb.org and https://image.tmdb.org; the path, query and key go along. TMDB traffic then goes only there, and only to a valid https address.
settings.replaces_the_progress_library_s: Replaces the progress, library, settings and modules on this device with the ones in the backup. Downloaded episodes and chapters are left alone.
settings.routes_tmdb_traffic_through_you: Routes TMDB traffic through your own endpoints, for regions that block it.
settings.runs_the_page_slider_click: Runs the page slider and the chapter buttons from right to left, and swaps the click sides with them.
settings.runs_the_page_slider_tap: Runs the page slider and the chapter buttons from right to left, and swaps the tap sides with them.
settings.search_keeps_its_own_button: Search keeps its own button at the end of the bar.
settings.sends_app_module_and_web: Sends app, module and web view requests through an HTTP CONNECT or SOCKS5 proxy. Not for video. Nothing goes out directly while it's down. Applies after a restart.
settings.set_while_watching_from_the: Set while watching, from the subtitles button. It carries over to the next video until you reset it.
settings.shadow_is_a_soft_dark: Shadow is a soft dark glow around the text, for bright scenes.
settings.shirox_switches_language_the_ne: Shirox switches language the next time it opens. Close it from the app switcher to switch now.
settings.sign_in_again_to_allow: Sign in again to allow syncing
settings.signs_shirox_out_of_websites: Signs Shirox out of websites and forgets solved Cloudflare checks; modules may ask you to verify again.
settings.styled_ass_subtitles_keep_their: Styled (.ass) subtitles keep their own fonts and colours; size and delay still apply.
settings.tap_sides_to_scroll_or: Tap Sides to Scroll or Turn
settings.tap_the_right_side_to: Tap the right side to scroll down or turn to the next page, the left to go back; right to left reading swaps them. The middle shows and hides the controls.
settings.the_browser_shirox_claims_to: The browser Shirox claims to be for modules, images and web views. Modules with their own, and solved Cloudflare checks, keep theirs.
settings.the_buttons_at_the_top: The buttons at the top of Home and Search: Home's picks the provider, Search's the module. Hidden, both keep the last choice; modules are also in Settings › Modules.
settings.the_language_shirox_shows_itsel: The language Shirox shows itself in, or the one your device uses.
settings.the_password_is_kept_in: The password is kept in the Keychain.
settings.this_application_uses_tmdb_and: This application uses TMDB and the TMDB APIs but is not endorsed, certified, or otherwise approved by TMDB.
settings.this_backup_will_contain_live: This backup will contain live login tokens for AniList, MyAnimeList and Jellyfin. Anyone who opens the file can sign in as you — keep it to yourself.
settings.this_device_doesnt_support_chan: This device doesn't support changing the app icon.
settings.this_permanently_removes_all_on: This permanently removes all on-device entries and collections. AniList/MyAnimeList lists are not affected.
settings.this_replaces_the_data_on: This replaces the data on this device.
settings.tracks_your_anime_shows_and: Tracks your anime, shows and movies on Simkl alongside AniList and MyAnimeList. Simkl has no manga.
settings.turn_pages_with_a_curl: Turn pages with a curl, like a book, in the paged reading modes. Turn off to slide them instead.
settings.turns_subtitles_on_or_off: Turns subtitles on or off in every video. The player's subtitles button changes it too.
settings.turns_the_player_to_the: Turns the player to the other landscape side even with Rotation Lock on in Control Center.
settings.use_when_one_account_is: Use when one account is simply the one you want to keep. Overwrites the other with it — progress, status, score and rewatch count — even where that means going backwards. Titles only the overwritten account has are left in place. This can't be undone.
settings.which_rendition_to_start_on: Which rendition to start on when a stream offers several. Auto lets the player adapt to your connection; a fixed choice falls back to the closest available.
settings.your_on_device_library_works: Your on-device library works without signing in. Auto-track keeps its Watching list in sync with what you watch.
